description: Copy ONE existing suite-level row of suite `suiteId` into a NEW suite-level row and save it. Use for "copy ITR-1 into ITR-2 in SU-24's test data and save". The copy is written to the SUITE-LEVEL test data ONLY — member test cases' own test data is NEVER touched. `from` names the source row (default: the suite default row, normally ITR-1); `name` names the new row (default: the next free ITR-N). The tool then reads the suite's test data back and confirms the new row exists. Refuses a duplicate row name.

environmentType.description: Environment key from tc_list_environments (e.g. general, general_1).

from.description: Source iteration name (e.g. "ITR-1") or id. Default: the suite default row.

name.description: Name for the new row (e.g. "ITR-2"). Default: next free ITR-N.

name: suite_copy_testdata
title: Copy a SUITE-LEVEL test-data row and save it on the suite
